quick: 0.5% solution, volume per procedure (typically 1 to 3 mL in dentistry)
summary: Centbucridine is a local anaesthetic developed by CDRI Lucknow, used mainly in dental and minor surgical infiltration in India. It is several times more potent than lidocaine and has some vasoconstrictor activity of its own.
indications: Infiltration and nerve-block anaesthesia (dental, minor surgery)

dosage.d: 0.5% solution, volume per procedure (typically 1 to 3 mL in dentistry)

admin: Use only as the finished product directs
preg: Safety not established; use only if clearly needed
lact: Safety not established; weigh benefit against unknown risk

common: Local pain, numbness beyond the procedure
serious: Systemic toxicity (CNS excitation, seizures, arrhythmia) with overdose or intravascular injection

counsel: Use exactly as the pack directs
Stop and seek care for rash, swelling or breathing difficulty
missed: Take it when remembered unless the next dose is due; do not double up.
overdose: Local anaesthetic systemic toxicity: airway, benzodiazepines for seizures, lipid emulsion.
